title: Describe a Shared Kitchen Event

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Prepare briefly and record your own response of 120–160 words. The sample is shorter than the 90–120 second target. Add relevant details and allow natural pauses while staying within 120–160 words.
prompt: Speak for about 90–120 seconds, using 120–160 words. Describe a fictional kitchen event, a person who helps, two tools and a menu choice. Explain how a visitor can ask about ingredients. Use at least six lesson words.
reference: I would invite a few neighbors to a small community kitchen event. The chef who leads the meeting would show us a simple vegetarian menu and explain each ingredient. We would meet in a room where there is enough space around the table. I would put a spoon, a fork and a knife on a tray before the guests arrive. One sauce might contain yogurt, so the staff would answer questions before anyone chooses a portion. I would listen to each person instead of guessing what they can eat. During the demonstration, we could talk about the aroma and the texture of the food. One guest may describe the flavor as sweet, while another says it is sour. At the end, I would write down ideas for another cuisine and thank everyone for joining.
